# Vendored third-party code

- `lame.min.js` — [lamejs](https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs) 1.2.1, an unmodified
  JavaScript port of the LAME MP3 encoder ([lame.sourceforge.net](https://lame.sourceforge.net)).
  License: LGPL (see `LICENSE-lamejs.txt`). Loaded as a separate script, lazily, only
  when the user clicks "Download MP3" in the playground.
